limitations: Imports the unreleased TOOLS-M1 CameraIdentity contract.
Does not descend from either unreleased TOOLS-M2 or TOOLS-M3 candidate.
Provides no image-pattern detector or captured-frame provider protocol.
Treats target coordinates as already expressed in the camera optical frame instead of estimating per-view target pose.
Provides no versioned JSON Schema, deterministic golden serialization, or public API baseline update.
Reports high residual as degraded reference quality but has no typed observation-rejection contract.

dependencies.blocking_evidence: PR 4734 has no protected merge and its Upstream consumer check failed.
CameraIdentity and camera-capability schemas are absent from protected main.
Acquisition/provider contracts are not protected authority and require current-main reconciliation.
The candidate is a sibling of, not a descendant of, TOOLS-M2 even though TOOLS-M3 depends on TOOLS-M2.

required_sequence.action: Protected-qualify and merge PR 4753, or incorporate its sparse-contract repair into a freshly reviewed M0/M1 replacement.
Rebuild TOOLS-M0 and TOOLS-M1 from then-current protected main and merge their versioned authority schemas through protected review.
Rebuild TOOLS-M2 on the exact immutable M1 release, split oversized acquisition code, and merge the bounded captured-frame/provider contract.
Rebuild TOOLS-M3 on the exact immutable M2 release and merge timing, synchronization, and provenance contracts.
Amend issue 4714 dependencies to include M2 and M3, then implement M4 from current protected main with contract-first tests and no candidate cherry-pick.
After protected M4 and M5 releases, publish immutable sanitized schemas and fixtures for AffineDrift 3962 parity qualification.

planned_m4.serialization: Versioned JSON Schema plus canonical golden JSON with finite-value and unknown-field rejection.
planned_m4.pattern_provider: Injectable detector protocol consuming bounded TOOLS-M2 CapturedFrame values and preserving TOOLS-M3 timestamps/provenance; OpenCV is an adapter, not the domain contract.
planned_m4.solver: Deterministic multi-view planar-target optimization jointly estimating camera intrinsics, distortion, and per-view target poses with bounded iterations and stable ordering.
planned_m4.uncertainty: Rank-checked covariance from a documented weighted residual Jacobian, with parameter order, units, conditioning limits, and non-identifiable failure explicit.
planned_m4.quality_and_rejection: Typed thresholds and explicit reject/degraded/pass outcomes for geometry, coverage, residuals, bounds, duplicate observations, and non-finite values.

consumer.note: The Affine branch is pedagogical only and correctly leaves Tools M4/M5 pins unavailable; it is not a protected release or parity authority.
